scope: Complete immutable CP-aligned prefix; running process unchanged; not terminal 12h result
limitations: Retreat events are not directly recorded in actions; controller death delta includes all actual retreats, visible_loadout_failure is a filtered actual-combat feedback subset.
Tour classification counts actions within start/end; domains outside a tour remain included in all-prefix counts.
Paid native growth means upgrade_slot/scientist_max/reactor_max button actions; it does not include resource pickup, allocations, hanging/forge costs or keyboard setup.
